data.cultural_impact: The name "Daariq" is believed to have originated from the Arabic root words ‘D-R-Q,’ which means 'to be bright or to bring light.' This name is also attributed to the Prophet Muhammad's companion, Darraq Al-Qahabi, who was known for his bravery and leadership during battles.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual sense, the name "Daariq" is associated with the extension and manifestation of Allah's light in the world. As Allah (SWT) says in the Quran, "Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth. His Light is what is taken in by the hearts illuminating them, and Allah is the Guiding Source to this Light" (Surah Al-An'am, Ayah 125). By being named "Daariq," one is reminded of their role as a beacon of light in the world, representing the qualities of courage, resilience, and fortitude in the face of adversity.
